user_id.label: User ID
user_id.description: Habitica User ID, sent as the x-api-user header. Find it under Settings → API.

api_token.label: API Token
api_token.description: Habitica API Token, sent as the x-api-key header. It is stored in Noctalia plugin settings.

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval
refresh_interval.description: How often to sync with Habitica, in seconds.

max_dailies.label: Dailies shown
max_dailies.description: Maximum number of due dailies in the panel.

max_todos.label: Todos shown
max_todos.description: Maximum number of open todos in the panel.

notification_badge.label: Show notification badge
notification_badge.description: Show the pending count on the bar widget.

show_habits.label: Show habits
show_habits.description: Add a Habits section with up and down scoring.

max_habits.label: Habits shown
max_habits.description: Maximum number of habits in the panel.

show_checklist.label: Show checklist items
show_checklist.description: Show dailies and todos checklists, and let them be scored.

tag_filter.label: Enable tag filtering
tag_filter.description: Only show tasks that carry the selected Habitica tag.

selected_tag.label: Selected Tag ID
selected_tag.description: Habitica tag UUID. Leave empty to show every task.

colorization.label: Enable colorization
colorization.description: Apply theme colors to the bar icon and pending count.
